entries.title: Proverbs 31:1
segments: ¶The words of Lemuel, king of Massa: the teaching which he had from his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:2
segments: What am I to say to you, O Lemuel, my oldest son? and what, O son of my body? and what, O son of my oaths?

entries.title: Proverbs 31:3
segments: Do not give your strength to women, or your ways to that which is the destruction of kings.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:4
segments: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to take wine, or for rulers to say, Where is strong drink?

entries.title: Proverbs 31:5
segments: For fear that through drinking they may come to have no respect for the law, wrongly judging the cause of those who are in trouble.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:6
segments: Give strong drink to him who is near to destruction, and wine to him whose soul is bitter:

entries.title: Proverbs 31:7
segments: Let him have drink, and his need will go from his mind, and the memory of his trouble will be gone.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:8
segments: Let your mouth be open for those who have no voice, in the cause of those who are ready for death.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:9
segments: Let your mouth be open, judging rightly, and give right decisions in the cause of the poor and those in need.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:10
segments: ¶Who may make discovery of a woman of virtue? For her price is much higher than jewels.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:11
segments: The heart of her husband has faith in her, and he will have profit in full measure.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:12
segments: She does him good and not evil all the days of her life.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:13
segments: She gets wool and linen, working at the business of her hands.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:14
segments: She is like the trading-ships, getting food from far away.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:15
segments: She gets up while it is still night, and gives meat to her family, and their food to her servant-girls.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:16
segments: After looking at a field with care, she gets it for a price, planting a vine-garden with the profit of her work.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:17
segments: She puts a band of strength round her, and makes her arms strong.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:18
segments: She sees that her marketing is of profit to her: her light does not go out by night.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:19
segments: She puts her hands to the cloth-working rod, and her fingers take the wheel.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:20
segments: Her hands are stretched out to the poor; yes, she is open-handed to those who are in need.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:21
segments: She has no fear of the snow for her family, for all those in her house are clothed in red.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:22
segments: She makes for herself cushions of needlework; her clothing is fair linen and purple.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:23
segments: Her husband is a man of note in the public place, when he takes his seat among the responsible men of the land.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:24
segments: She makes linen robes and gets a price for them, and traders take her cloth bands for a price.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:25
segments: Strength and self-respect are her clothing; she is facing the future with a smile.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:26
segments: Her mouth is open to give out wisdom, and the law of mercy is on her tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:27
segments: She gives attention to the ways of her family, she does not take her food without working for it.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:28
segments: Her children get up and give her honour, and her husband gives her praise, saying,

entries.title: Proverbs 31:29
segments: Unnumbered women have done well, but you are better than all of them.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:30
segments: Fair looks are a deceit, and a beautiful form is of no value; but a woman who has the fear of the Lord is to be praised.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:31
segments: Give her credit for what her hands have made: let her be praised by her works in the public place.
